notes.title: Release 0.97.0
notes.notes:
With this update, we are introducing our first (of many to come) social feature - Aim Lab Friends! You can use this feature to keep up with your friends, view their latest replay, Aim Lab rank, total plays, and more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/b56a467b3845e5b59ac1ec2cf2dd00f119755493.gif[/img]

Alongside the shiny, new friends system, we are also adding Titles. Titles will be your way of showcasing what kind of an aimer you are and will appear on the leaderboards near your name. 
Choose wisely!

[h3][b]How do I add friends or equip a title?[/b][/h3]

Click on the friends icon on top right of the screen! If you see a golden title that is locked but you reeeallly want it, head over to our new and improved Store page, where some skin bundles now include a title.

[h3][b]New Skins[/b][/h3]

While browsing the new store, you’ll see we’ve added the Wave Passage & Starfall skins for the 9mm and Shadow weapons. Starfall also unlocks the “Star Aimer” title.

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]

-Resolution reverted to native when pressing ALT + tab 
-Vertical monitor could be selected by default on first time user set-up 
-Aim Lab could occasionally default to the wrong display for users with multiple displays
-Resolution change revert only worked if it was changing displays and if the game was kept in focus
-When a resolution change was reverted, the failed settings were still saved
-Selecting a display set the resolution and refresh rate dropdowns to the default/max value instead of the saved value
-Fallback display sometimes used native settings instead of saved settings
-Typing "r" while writing a bug report in the post task results screen pulled up replay modal

notes.title: Aim Lab 0.96.7 (Replays, New Skins & Bug Fixes!)
notes.notes:
[i]0.96.7 is here and comes with some of the biggest new features since Creator Studio! First up, Replays are here! Aim Lab now captures task plays so that you can view and compare runs against yourself and other Aim Lab players. You’ll be able to speed up and slow down playback and see useful visualizations like your leading and trailing mouse path as well as the optimal mouse path to improve your aim! You can also now see your most recent scores for all tasks and quickly access additional data and replays from the Training menu. We’ve also fixed some of the more annoying bugs, such as leaderboards not saving what time frame you last viewed. We’ve laid out all of the details below![/i]

[b]Replays:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/be66c2a9435eda5b7696c6b5bc5c853450ebfcc8.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Replays are supported for majority of tasks. When you complete a play of a supported task from this patch onward, a replay will automatically be generated.

[*] Replays will show a 1:1 playback of the position and behavior of targets, how the player aimed and moved, and the progression of their score during the play.

[*] You can view replays at up to 1.5x speed or down to 0.1x speed.

[*] Replays have additional analytics such as visualizing the path the crosshair moved and the most optimal path a player could have taken to a target. Additional analytics will be coming later.

[*] Some recent plays before this patch may be partially supported. A task play that is partially supported may have missing features compared to a task play from this patch onward.
[/list]

[b]Play Viewer:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/6e22f8099e65f9862e0e296e76d3c2660e318c67.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] A new place to watch replays and compare task metrics against yourself as well as other Aim Lab players!

[*] See how a specific run stacks up against your last run and personal best scores, or check out other player runs to see what they’re doing so you can improve.

[*] Share your replays and play data with others by clicking the Share button to generate a link that you can send to others for them to view.

[*] You can open the Play Viewer in a few different ways:

[*] From the Recent Play Graphs in the Training menu.

[*] After completing a run from the results screen by clicking on “View Replay” or pressing 'R'.

[*] You can also view other player runs by clicking on the Compare icon button in any leaderboard row.

[/list]
[b]Recent Plays Graphs:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/d22e424a2cee3a0730f5792effda654c8384ce82.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] We wanted to surface your recent plays in a more accessible way, so we put a new graph in the Training menu!

[*] When you have played a task before, instead of seeing the task preview, you will now see a graph of your scores from the last 50 plays for the task. You can swap to viewing the preview if you need a refresher.

[*] Mouse over the plays to see a detailed score and date of the play, and click on the plays to pull up additional data on the play and watch the replay.
[/list]

We have 4 new skins hitting the store this patch! Featuring skins for the R4-C, SCAR, and 416-C, these skins are based on some fan-favorite pros!

notes.title: Aim Lab 0.95.6 The Big One (Features, bug fixes, and quality of life overhauls!)
notes.notes:
Tightly packed into this release are some of the most requested features and quality of life overhauls. We’ve spent time upgrading our controller support - a huge ask from the community, reworked playlists to the point it’s launching as v2.0, included accessibility options, all while squashing another metric ton of bugs including a pesky log in issue! 
Let’s dive in

[h3]Enhanced Controller Support[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/2ee715191b496cac3c0e434d3df5d73dafadbada.gif[/img]

One of the biggest feature requests from the controller community has been enhanced support. This patch brings a complete overhaul for our players which now includes full cursor UI navigation and interaction for controller users. We've also made some quality of life improvements to help make modifying key bindings for controllers more user-friendly and to handle controller connectivity interruptions.

[h3]Playlist V2.0[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/8c22542bf92cfac0117f185df8f71295ff6b2e8e.png[/img]

Playlists have been revamped with a new UI along with fixing some on-going functionality issues and overall bringing a hugely improved experience. 

[h3]Target Kill Latency Reduction[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/1dce90ab415e197e40d000f8974245f4c4613e99.png[/img]

We've reduced the latency when a target is both killed and spawns resulting in smoother gameplay - ultimately meaning the gameplay experience will be more fluid for everyone. 

[h3]Target Colorblind options[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/9e88de2ca872e4df2809f38cc7880abc2e273b83.png[/img]

As we strive to improve our accessibility, we’ve implemented colorblind-friendly target colors including Tritanopia, Deuteranopioa & Protanopia to make it easier for those who need it to distinguish the target differences. 

To find the options, go to settings, game, and they are included in the list of target color options.

If there are any other accessibility options you wanted to see included, make sure to reach out to us on Discord or Twitter. 

[h3]Fixed - User Login / Session Expired[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/5c470c45415c58f81991fa0ae7e19b3efbfd44a1.png[/img]

notes.title: Aim Lab Update 0.94.8 - Aim Lab x Valorant 2
notes.notes:
We’re at it again with VALORANT Challengers, and bringing you a new Aim Lab x VALORANT Combine! That means new prizes, new tasks to test your skills, a new player card, and even an exclusive task by Sentinels pro TenZ await you!

And if that’s not enough great VALORANT content, you can also check out the all-new VALORANT profile page under the “Profile” section in-game, where you’ll find our first steps towards breaking down your VALORANT stats and putting information and practice options all at your fingertips.


[h2]The Combine[/h2]

Consisting of four new tasks and an exclusive task by Sentinels pro TenZ, this new combine will test your skills in both aggressive and defensive situations, as well as your peeking and precision - And as with before, you’re ranked on your plays and get a nifty player card once you complete the combine!

To accompany this - We are also giving 100 lucky winners a chance to win $25 by sharing your player cards - To enter, all you need to do is share your player card on twitter with the #AimLabCombine tag, and of course to give us a cheeky follow!

Not a fan of Twitter? Don’t worry - there are prizes in-game too! 

The top 5 winners in each main task will bag themselves a tidy $100 - And the top 5 on TenZ’s task will win a Sentinels jersey - signed by TenZ himself!

And for those of you out there looking to give it your all - The top 5 players on top of the overall leaderboards will be winning two tickets each for the VALORANT NA Last Chance Qualifiers event!

 

The combine will run from August 11th to August 25th, and will end at 5:59 EST on August 25th, so be sure to get your hours in!

 

[h2]The Tasks[/h2]

[h3]VCT Haven Short Entry[/h3]

This task focuses on your entry skills, peeking and map awareness - Targets appear all over the entry line in common positions and shoot back if you overexpose yourself. Peek carefully, peek quickly, and push forward.


[h3]VCT Split Angle Hold[/h3]

Holding an angle and knowing how far away from an angle to hold for your reaction time and abilities is critical in any defensive role - And that’s something this task will stress test. Waves of three targets will rush across your screen towards a kill box, and your job is just to kill them.

Sounds simple - But don’t let that fool you. Get your lineups right and go for gold!


[h3]VCT Breeze Headshot[/h3]

VALORANT isn’t all about the close range engagements - Long angles and sightlines come with their own set of challenges, and no map highlights this more than Breeze.

This task will pit you against a single enemy going from Breeze B main to B site, taking three bodyshots or a single headshot. Aim for the head and take your time.


[h3] VCT Bind Wallpeek[/h3]

Defending a site can be tricky, especially when you want to stick it to the enemy team. That’s what this task will help you with - Defend your site from attacking enemies, and try not to get shot.


[h3]TenZ Haven Clutch[/h3]

Take a walk in the pros shoes - Relive a clutch moment from TenZ first hand!

This task pits you on Haven A Site and floods you with constant targets - When one dies, a new one will spawn. 

Experience the tension that can only come from a clutch situation, and develop your skills until it becomes second nature.



[h2]VALORANT Profile [/h2]

Are you a VALORANT player looking for statistical insights in order to improve? Good news: our VALORANT profile is here! When you connect your Riot account to Aim Lab (if you haven’t done so already), we’ll start pulling your match data in order to help you see how you stack up. 

This is the first step towards building deeper statistical insights within Aim Lab so everything is at your fingertips, and you can go straight from analyzing your performance to practicing with just a couple clicks of the mouse.

Let us know what you think!
 


[h2]Creator Studio updates[/h2]

Added a Score Bonus for Time Remaining, and a penalty for time elapsed option for creators

Added a new “Bot switch on kill” modifier

Added new lighting objects

Added a new w”Min/Max” elevation option for the Sphere behavior

Added a new Hitbox multiplier to modify damage to different hitboxes (Head, Body, Legs)

Added a new scaler option for Headshot bots to allow separate scaling of the Head and Body

notes.title: Aim Lab Update 0.94.7 - The Search Update
notes.notes:
Search is here! Gone are the days of spending half of your training in menus or struggling to find that one task - Now, with the new search functionality, you can access any of the 10,000+ Tasks, Playlists and Scenarios right from the main menu!

[h3]Search[/h3]

Many of you have been asking for us to cut down on the amount of menus you need to travel through to get to where you want to be - So we decided to cut out the middleman entirely! 

The new "Search" functionality will allow you to search for any task, playlist or Scenario directly from the home screen - That means no downtime, no waiting, and no fuss! This feature will be available for all players with 0.94.7 - All you need to do is type the name, or any part of the name of a task, playlist or scenario in the new search bar and click to play! 

You can also quickly tap CTRL + F in any menu or at the end of a task to open the search bar anywhere!

 

[h3]Kill and Spawn sounds [/h3]

Alongside Hit sounds, you can now set a custom "Spawn" and "Kill" sound for all tasks! To set your new Spawn and Kill sounds, go to settings -> Audio and toggle them on, then set the sound up however you like and hit save - It's just that easy! 

But what are new sound options without new sounds to go with them? Well, no worries - This update brings a whole host of new sounds pre-loaded into Aim Lab for your customisation needs! No longer are you stuck with the clanky sounds of the default metal hitsounds!

 

[h3]Tracking Tasks Update [/h3]

Many of you have been enjoying the recently created tracking tasks - Reactivetrack, Startrack, etc. Well, we wanted to make sure you had the most bang for your buck when it comes to training - All five new tracking tasks now have a Speed and Precision variant! That means you can now play Arctrack, Startrack, Reactivetrack, Spheretrack and Spheretrack90 in Ultimate, Speed or Precision modes - Along with their own leaderboards! 

 

[h3]New Visual Settings[/h3]

You’ll find some new options in the “Visuals” settings this update - Namely a new Shadows option and a new Override option for workshop tasks

The new “Shadows” setting will give you the ability to enable or disable shadows globally, and the new Override setting will allow you to override a creators colour settings to ensure that a task is perfectly suited to your preferences!

Along with this, you will also find some new skyboxes and skybox settings - From the beautiful new Galaxy skies to a solid colour skybox for those desiring simplicity, the new settings have something for everyone!

And for creators - These new skyboxes are immediately supported within Creator Studio tasks, so you will be able to select from any of the new skyboxes for your own creations! 

 

[h3]General Bug Fixes [/h3]

Fixed an issue that would cause Steam to say Aim Lab is still running after being closed in specific circumstances 

Fixed an issue that would cause some users to be stuck at the "Retrieving User" menu

Fixed various issues with both standard and custom crosshairs

Fixed an issue preventing both Siege and Valorant tasks from being playable under specific circumstances

Fixed an issue with weapons firing at a high fire rate having a clipping firing sound

Various lighting fixes for Creator Studio tasks

Fixed an issue with humanoid-style targets causing them to have no leg hitbox

Fix for issues with favourited tasks not having the right previews

notes.notes:
First and foremost - A huge thank you to both the community and competitors that got involved in the Aim Lab Skills Challenge! The competition was fierce, the chat lively, and the aim on point!

I can’t wait to share with you the details of the next Aim Lab Skills Challenge - But to help tide you over until then, as you may have seen during the tournament, we’ve launched our first Premium service - Playerbase!



[h2]Playerbase[/h2]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=owsBJP8ZDOA]Welcome to Playerbase! [/url]
Playerbase is a player development platform aimed at connecting players with world class coaches and content creators.

Playerbase makes it easy for creators, coaches and communities to market and monetize their unique skill sets and talents - And makes it just as easy for players to find the coaches best suited to them!

Playerbase Partners will be able to set various tiers of subscription offerings, allowing players to choose their level of commitment based on the services they want. These services can include, but are not limited to: custom Aim Lab training tasks, unique Aim Lab task lists tailored to the subscriber, 1-on-1 coaching sessions, detailed guides from gaming professionals, opportunities for group classes, vod review sessions, private Discord channels and full skill analysis for subscribers. Think of it kind of like Patreon, but dedicated to help gamers to improve.

notes.title: The Zedd Takeover: Patch Notes - 0.94.2
notes.notes:
Everybody loves music - And most of us love to train with it.

So we decided to bring that power to your practice - We’re partnering with Zedd to bring the power of music to your training!

A new theme, new music options, and a nice new lobby takeover await you in Aim Lab 0.94.2 - The Zedd Takeover



[h2]Ranking System Overhaul[/h2]

We’re giving our ranking system some love this update - With a total overhaul!

Not only will these changes make the rank you get more respective of your current skill level, but with new progression visuals and a whole new player card, you’ll be able to flex off to your friends too!



[i][h3]New ranking calculation[/h3][/i]

Our old ranking system was fairly complex and took quite some time to reflect your improvements - Using a median of your last 100 plays per category, getting your rank to shift took a long while.

Well, no longer - Our new ranking system, instead of taking a median of your last 100 plays, instead takes a median of your top 5 plays per category. This system will better keep up with you as you improve, while still allowing you to have a data profile as large as your aim can endure.

 

[i][h3]New Progression Visuals[/h3][/i]

Along with the new calculations, we are replacing some of our old ranking screens with a new progression-based screen.

This new ranking element will show you both what rank you are, and how far you are away from your next rank right on the homescreen!

 

[i][h3]New playercard[/h3][/i]

After all of these new changes - We figured that you might want a way to show off your stats to your friends - Well, we’ve got you covered!

The “Profile” screen has been completely reworked - Into a new ranked playercard!

This new profile menu will show off your overall rank, your per-category ranks, your strengths and weaknesses, aswell as still letting you access all of your old data!



[i][h3]Rank Up Screen[/h3][/i]

Improving is important - And should be celebrated.

So, as a last little cherry on the cake - Whenever you rank up after a task, you’ll get a little celebratory screen to congratulate you, aswell as a well deserved round of applause!

We expect you to be seeing this screen a lot - So don’t dissapoint us

We’re partnering with the legend himself to bring the power of music to your training - Featuring a new theme song, lobby takeover and more options for you to customize your Aim Lab experience - With more to come!

A new suggested task box has been added to the results screen once you complete a task - Allowing you to rapidly go from task to task to get the most out of your training!

This new section is in beta - So expect suggestions to get smarter over time!

notes.title: Patch Notes: EB 0.93.1
notes.notes:
[h1]New Tracking Tasks![/h1]

This week’s update brings you 5 new tracking tasks, from reactive tracking to tasks focused purely on smoothness, this update brings something for everyone! Each task aims to highlight a different component of tracking to help you become the best tracker you can be!

[h2]Spheretrack90[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/18856a61d20be5eb953e5b414d8a07ed972aa819.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/18856a61d20be5eb953e5b414d8a07ed972aa819.gif[/img][/url]

A remix on the task you all know and love - Spheretrack90 plays very similarly to the normal Spheretrack, but with a catch, the target will always remain in front of the player!

This should no doubt help out those of you that found yourselves running out of mousepad space, but on top of this, the focus is shifted more towards accuracy over resetting your mouse. It will help you in practicing tracking engagements against enemies that are mostly in front of you, rather than moving all around you. Spheretrack90 is super useful for games like Apex Legends or Hyperscape, for targets that stay mostly in front of you, but that are quite dynamic.

[h2]Arctrack[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/f07a75748a7bbc808ad064dd4aa3710469784055.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/f07a75748a7bbc808ad064dd4aa3710469784055.gif[/img][/url]

A new task with a new Greybox variant - Arctrack has you tracking a target that moves in a plain circle in front of you, with relatively high consistency and predictability.

This task focuses more on general smoothness and predictive tracking over anything else, and applies more generally to the games you play, rather than being better suited to one or the other.

[h2]Startrack[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/055e75e7d9ccbc15c3ac148de4a56fc15389333c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/055e75e7d9ccbc15c3ac148de4a56fc15389333c.gif[/img][/url]

A new favorite of mine personally, Startrack! It’s another smoothness based task in the same vein as Linetrace, with one key difference, instead of shooting two targets at the end of a tracking target you follow a target as it moves between "Ghost" targets. The combination of vertical and horizontal tracking enables you to better engage enemies with jumping abilities, such as an updrafting Jett or a Jump padding Octane.

[h2]Microstartrack[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/e1bbc3b4c2eb193bdf4d36190db554ceea07aee1.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/e1bbc3b4c2eb193bdf4d36190db554ceea07aee1.gif[/img][/url]

A variant of Startrack, Microstartrack combines reactivity and smoothness by spawning targets much closer together - Super hand for games with reactive targets like Overwatch, Warzone or Apex.

[h2]Reactivetrack[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/c08270da15883642a935e1826fd18a4067ca2b14.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/c08270da15883642a935e1826fd18a4067ca2b14.gif[/img][/url]

A new tracking task focused purely on reactive tracking - Face a target that changes direction rapidly and try your best to stay on target as much as possible. This task is pretty much perfect for those of you that have trouble dealing with enemies that change directions frequently, and should be a perfect fit for those looking to improve your performance against higher level opponents.

notes.title: Update 0.50 EB Patch Notes(New Rank system, Valorant Scope Variants & Hotfixes)
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 0.50 EB is here! And along with it comes a total ranking overhaul, new ranks, Valorant Operator Scope Variants and a slew of bug fixes![/h1]

[i][b]Ranking overhaul[/b][/i]

You've probably noticed that your rank in Aim Lab has changed since the last major update - For some of you it will be lower, and for others it will be higher. This is because the fundamental calculations behind how rank points are given has changed.

Prior to Update 0.50EB, rank points for things like Flicking or Tracking were assigned based on Accuracy, rather than real performance. This meant that players with insanely high performance that suffered a few misses would have less rank points than a player that shot a target once in a round. This system, as many pointed out, was fundamentally flawed.

After Update 0.50EB, rank points are given based on your score and performance in a round. This ties back into the scoring overhaul that we pushed live just the other day - As scoring is now far more indicative of performance, ranking has been changed to use your score far more than an individual metric.

As a general rule, every rank point you get is equivalent to 1000 score, averaged across the category. Rank points of 100 in a category would mean that your average score in said category is 100,000, whereas rank points of 50 in a category mean that your average score in said category is 50,000.

This system will be receiving constant, and consistent balancing tweaks to ensure that normalisation and score assignment feel appropriate, so expect more changes to follow.

[i][b]New Ranks![/b][/i]

Previously, the ranks you could earn in Aimlab progressed as follows - Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master, with each subsection going from 1-4. 1 being lowest and 4 being highest.

Update 0.50 EB brings three new ranks to the table - Ruby, Emerald and Grandmaster.

You can now expect ranking to progress as follows - Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Ruby, Emerald, Diamond, Master, and finally, Grandmaster. A final, prestigious rank will be implemented at a later time, so expect to hear more about it down the line.

Furthermore - The way ranks progress has been changed a little. Before, a rank of Diamond 1 meant you were at the lowest portion of the Diamond rank. Now, inversely, a rank of Diamond 4 would mean you are at the lowest portion of the Diamond rank, whereas a rank of Diamond 1 would put you at the border of Master.

And lastly - You will now notice a rank emblem beside your scorecard, you can view every rank emblem in the game (As of Update 0.50 EB) here!

[b][h1]It's a pretty big one this week ladies and gents - After much community feedback we've added four long-requested tasks into Aim Lab![/h1][/b]
[h3]
[u][b]Switchtrack[/b][/u][/h3]

Switchtrack is a multi-target task with a simple goal - Track a target, destroy it, then find a new target as quickly as you can. Multiple targets spawn at once at different heights, making it easy to plan out a chain, while still being challenging to execute.

[h3][u][b]Spidershot 180[/b][/u][/h3]

Looking to get your 180 flicks down? Spidershot 180 can help with that.

Spidershot 180 is similar in most ways to Spidershot, with one big twist - After every target, you will need to flick 180 degrees and destroy the target behind you. You'll no doubt find this to be the ultimate challenge of precision and control.

Spidershot 180 is also available in "Warmup" mode, accessible via the "Sandbox" section. In this mode, there is no time limit, no end screen, and no delays. Simply play for as long as you want!

[h3][u][b]Sixshot[/b][/u][/h3]

Those of you that have been in our community for long enough are probably aware of the community "War Crime" task - Tiny targets at a long distance.

Sixshot can be seen as a mix of this community-created task and Gridshot - Six, very, very small targets spawn in an 8x8 grid, and your goal is simply to destroy them as quickly as you are able to.

Sixshot presents itself as the ultimate test of precision and speed against stationary targets, and will no doubt prove a challenge for even the most seasoned FPS player.

[h3][u][b]Strafebot[/b][/u][/h3]

Strafebot takes advantage of the AI enemies you may have encountered in Freeplay - Human scale enemies that fight back.

Movement in this task is almost entirely free, so you have the perfect opportunity to practice your strafing while you aim - A necessity, because stand still for too long and you're liable to catch a bullet.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.42 EB
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy new year from the Aim Lab Team![/h1]
 
[b]We're back at you again with Update 0.42EB - Bringing with it a whole bunch of love to the Profile menu, a new mode for training projectile-based weapons and a full Reaction time breakdown chart!
 
[u]New Features[/u][/b]
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/9af273dfb654b798763997bceb464fe316c3b324.png[/img]
[*][b]Predictionshot -[/b] Most games back in the day relied on a system called "Hitscan", in which the second you shot, an invisible laser would go from your crosshair to where you were looking. Instantly.
As games have developed, so to have ballistic systems, as such we see more and more games straying from the Hitscan style and moving more into Realism, with bullets travelling as they would in real life.
Predictionshot aims to help all players, from veterans to new players, to get to grips with leading targets by instinct.
Predictionshot is an expansion upon the standard Strafeshot mode - Featuring an indicator for where you should be firing to ensure that your shot lands where your target will be, rather than where it is.
This indicator is dynamic, meaning it changes based on distance, target speed and even the speed of the projectile of your weapon, so don't be afraid to set up a custom weapon to run this mode - It's what it's made for after all.
You can find Predictionshot in the "Sandbox" category of modes.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/c6be48a5f60a2c33edf38ce65b4b41ce639a0b7c.png[/img]
[*][b]Task Data History -[/b] A long requested feature - We are happy to announce the introduction of proper historical graphs for your performance!
These can be found in the "Profile" section of the game, under the new "Task Data" tab.
This new history section allows you to see everything you'll need to build an idea of your improvements, from your score over time to your average performance and percentiles - To your best result in any of the six categories provided!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/7070d7b4e5a494d060d55d8110a2644307156cdb.png[/img]
[*][b]Reaction Time and Gain Breakdown -[/b] Another long requested feature - Once again found in the Profile section. You will find the "Reports" category has been added, and with it - A full breakdown of your Reaction Time and Gain average.
You will find your Reaction Time broken down into 3 parts
[olist][*]Perceptual Speed, or how long it takes you to identify a target
[*]Cognitive Speed, or how long it takes you to decide to shoot a target after identifying it
[*]And finally - Motor Speed, or how long in Milliseconds it takes you to flick to your intended target.
[/olist]These three categories cover all aspects of your engagement time, and, as such, are best used to help diagnose what is holding you back, helping you to see if it's your movements that are slow, or if you take a little too long to decide to shoot, making it a useful tool for players and coaches alike!
[/list]
 

[u][b]Fixes, Improvements and QoL Changes[/b][/u]
[list][*]Fixed bug when typing certain keys in the bug report window that caused interactions with the UI
[*]Fixed incorrect preview videos being shown for tasks
[*]Fixed percentile maxes for all tasks

notes.title: Total UI Redesign! New gun! Holiday Charity Skin Event! Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
It's finally here!

Welcome to version EB 0.40 - A new UI, a new gun, and a great cause!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/879238a0a8a3a74d1828613bb7b0e1ad03289d55.png[/img]
[b]New UI[/b]

EB 0.40 brings a fresh coat of paint to Aim Lab in more ways than one - You will find the *entire* user interface has been redesigned from the ground up to be more simplistic, easier to follow, and beyond all - Convenient.

This new UI brings many long-sought features to Aim Lab, from a pre-task and in-task video to help you understand the task better, to the ability to *instantly open your leaderboards score after a round*, and just about everything inbetween.

Post round feedback has received a fresh lick of paint too - Including vital fixes to percentiles and feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/97bb975919666ea9819be3d6a14919c83bbe62f3.png[/img]

This will, in time, become the default weapon for most tasks, taking the place of the 9mm as a spiritual successor, but right now - It's just along for the ride.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/b69230d64ec0b64c46837cfba22c54212cf843df.png[/img]
[b]New feature - Crosshair uploading[/b]

Ever had your eyes on a crosshair in a game that you just can't replicate? Or perhaps one a little outlandish? Well, now you can upload just about any image as a custom crosshair for your shooting pleasure! Aim with anything from a dot to a square picture of Danny Devito, and everything in-between!

And finally, in keeping with the Christmas spirit...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/a40618bd2839d5e1ec56c05527cde21f8ef74eac.png[/img]
[b]Aim lab x Gamers Outreach[/b]

We're proud to announce our partnership with [url=https://gamersoutreach.org/]Gamers Outreach[/url] - A charity helping to bring videogames and joy to millions of children across America!

Gamers Outreach is doing amazing things not just for gaming - But for gamers as a whole. And we're happy to play our part.

Furthermore - 100% of all profits go directly to Gamers Outreach and their GO Kart program - Bringing gaming to kids in need.

Thank you to every single player that has supported us so far - We are only where we are because of you, and this amazing community you have come together to create.


From every single one of us here at Aim Lab - [b]Happy Holidays![/b]

notes.title: Upcoming Update: UI Overhaul
notes.notes:
Later this coming week we will be posting a road map to show you guys a little more of what we have going on in the background and what to expect over the coming weeks months for Aim Lab. Things such as Workshop support, Academy etc. But, first we would like to say thanks to everyone for sending us your suggestions, bug reports and feedback in general, its been a tremendous help and we are so lucky to have such a wonderful, passionate community! That being said we have had a decent gap in updates lately and I am here to show you what we have been working on in that time that is just about ready for release. This post will serve as a preview to the upcoming UI overhaul and we have completely redesigned Aim Lab from the ground up(all your tasks are exactly the same) but the UI is now a lot easier to see, read, navigate and looks fantastic. The screenshots and info I share below is still likely to change a bit.


LOGIN
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/6c8b04349c504e9abf5b3e509ec8628308e9b116.png[/img]
Not much has changed here functionality wise but we have redesigned it to look much cleaner.


HOME SCREEN
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/90a9be7e27f9a6a833ad8c03ddd70cdfd5712d18.png[/img]
This is still a tad unfinished and a few last min tweaks need made but for the most part is complete. We added quick tab buttons to hop between the different main menu pages.
As you can see assessment has been removed, which I will go more into detail about when we get to the new loadout screen. 


SETTINGS
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/80448331e445e653cf9c2e034f6e2be3403775ad.png[/img]
Mostly just a redesign here with the change to the targets tab to “Game” this will have the same target options that were there as well as a new option that we will talk about a little closer to release.


TASK SELECTION
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/04ca059f74296b1d7a7116888de0f5808da823c6.png[/img]
Another nice redesign here, however based on some recent decisions made this screen will most likely be revamped a little further down the road once we implement some new features.


Leaderboards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/456a9b15eea85fe83ca53cf1dcf91224a0a89839.png[/img]
Starting to look a little cleaner, easier to sort and find the scores you want.


LOADOUT
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/f051cf2f9eb7592cbb5ee592dc4b72b7a373b3f0.png[/img]
This is the new loadout screen it shows a small video showing what the task you are playing is like, allows you to select weapon, map and displays your selected weapon front and center. There will be lots of tweaks coming to this screen in the future which I will go over in more detail in the roadmap being announced later in the week. Here you will also see a checkbox labeled “Practice Only”. Previously we had 2 separate menus with the exact same tasks in each of those menus “Training” & “Assessment” the difference between the 2 was with training your stats do not impact your skill card/data profile  and scores do not get posted to leaderboards. So rather than having 2 separate menus, checking practice only will make it so your scores are not posted to leaderboards or effect your training data.


LOADING SCREEN
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/0f9c75b0e26acd1baae05e95e7e96b5e7f4472bb.png[/img]
Redesigned to be easier to read and show a small video of the upcoming task, this video will be replaced in the future with full video/audio instructions on how the task is played and how it benefits you.


RESULTS SCREENS
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/da82435195e5fd9e126556b9a9c13ccd61c0131c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30632227/a02fa2a967fabca0ead185ca075474ee6483ebde.png[/img]
These are still a work in progress but are looking a lot better, you guys asked for keyboard shortcuts to quickly do things such as exit, share and replay task so thats exactly what we did here. Insights on the right tell you how you performed based on previous plays, this is just the first step in bringing you guys more in depth analysis and starting to offer a way to show progress over time much more to come on this in the near future. Leaderboards will also eventually have their own tab here to see stats for this specific task. Also more sharing options coming soon(Facebook, Twitter etc)



Again thanks for sticking around on this wild ride as we continue to attempt to make Aim Lab the best it can be, please continue with the Feedback and Bug Reports its helped tremendously and we look forward to hearing from each one of you. Let us know in the comments what you think of the new redesign, any questions you have or anything else you'd like us to know!

notes.title: Aim Lab – Celebrating our 150th update
notes.notes:
[h1]Thanks to all the help from YOU our wonderful community we are celebrating our 150th update. You guys are awesome and help us with great ideas, feedback and tracking down issues. Here is what we have accomplished recently. Thank you all so much for your continued support as we move towards a full release.[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Completely new UI -[/b]  Categorizes tasks as well as separates Training and Assessment, new look, new feel.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30632227/2713f827754bc1124749cb6d780a858d0c8bad8c.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Training -[/b] Allows users to train without scores reflecting on stats and leaderboards so you can train to get better.
[*][b]Assessment -[/b] This is where you go to flex and show off your skill, tasks played in this section will count towards leaderboards and will be analyzed in the main menus score card as well as the data profile.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: Early Access Build - 0.52 EA
notes.notes:
[h1]02/25/2018 - [Early Access Build] - 0.52 EA[/h1]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Added option to control Hitsound volume separately
[*]Added new weapon selection menu prior to starting task - Current weapon being used and a button to change now located at top of menu system
Clicking CHANGE will bring up weapon selection options
[*]Removed randomness from impact events when bullets collide with objects. This will eliminate the appearance of recoil on some weapons and give a true depiction of where each miss landed
[*]Added new feedback system for missed shots. Short red impact flash to signal where your shot missed and point of impact, as well as a decal system that leaves a bullet hole of your last shot up in the scene. When a new shot is missed, the previous decal hole is removed, leaving only 1 bullet hole to indicate your last miss at a time. This is in contrast to the earlier decal system, that allowed an infinite number of bullet decals that at times made it difficult to see small targets against the backdrop of bullet decals
[*]Changed decal color to red to make sure it is readable at a distance and on light colored background
[*]Increased Max FPS slider limit from 240 to 300
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug that caused inaccurate weapon spread in some modes when using SCAR
[*]Fixed bug that would cause P to cause issues pausing the game
[*]Fixed bug that would allow you to tap fire faster than max autofire rate with some weapons
[*]Fixed bug that would cause Countryside Freeplay to restart into Spidershot Warmup
[/list]
